species.name: Great Frigatebird
species.range: widespread breeder, islands of tropical Indian and Pacific oceans, local east of eastern Brazil (tropical Atlantic Ocean); pelagic when non-breeding, ranging throughout tropical Indian and tropical and subtropical Pacific oceans

species.name: Christmas Island Frigatebird
species.range: breeds Christmas Island (east-central Indian Ocean); ranges Andaman Sea and Gulf of Thailand across Sunda Shelf to South China Sea and Sulu Sea (southwestern Philippines)

species.name: Cape Gannet
species.range: breeds islands off southern Africa; disperses to coastal Mozambique

species.name: Red-footed Booby
species.range: widespread tropical and subtropical ocean islands, in Caribbean and southwestern Atlantic islands: islands east of Brazil, Boatswain Bird Island (just off Ascension Island, south-central South Atlantic Ocean); islands off Belize and eastern Honduras; Cayman Islands through Lesser Antilles and islands north of Venezuela; small islands of Malagasy region, Chagos Archipelago, Cocos (Keeling) and Christmas islands (tropical Indian Ocean); Flores and Banda seas islands, islands northwest and east of Australia, Tench (St. Matthias Group, north-central Bismarck Archipelago), many other islands in outer Melanesia including New Caledonia, Tubbataha Reefs (west-central Philippines), Spratly Islands (South China Sea), southern Japanese offshore islands, Taiwan, Micronesia through Hawaiian Islands, and Pitcairn group (eastern Polynesia); islands west of Mexico, Costa Rica, and Colombia, and Galapagos

species.name: Brown Booby
species.range: widespread tropical and subtropical ocean islands; Cape Verde Islands (southern Macaronesia), Boatswain Bird Island (just off Ascension, south-central South Atlantic Ocean), Alcatraz Island (west of northwestern Guinea), and Gulf of Guinea islands, Caribbean islands off Yucatan Peninsula and Honduras to Panama and southwestern Colombia, Bahamas and Cayman Islands to Lesser Antilles, islands north of Venezuela and Tobago and off Brazil, islands off Somalia and Socotra, Aldabra, and Madagascar, and Chagos Archipelago, Cocos (Keeling), and Christmas islands (tropical Indian Ocean), islands off northern Australia, Tench (St. Matthias group, north-central Bismarck Archipelago), remote islands in Melanesia; many islands of southern Japan including Kyushu; Taiwan; offshore islands of Philippines, Vietnam, and Malaysia, in Flores and Banda seas, from Marianas and Palau through Hawaiian Islands and Gambier Islands (eastern Tuamotu Archipelago; eastern Polynesia)

species.name: Masked Booby
species.range: breeds islands in Red Sea and northwestern Arabian Sea, Malagasy region through Indian Ocean to Cocos (Keeling) Island, northern Australia, Lord Howe, Norfolk, and Kermadec islands, northward to islets of far southern Japan, and eastward in Pacific to Hawaii, Easter Islands, islands off western Mexico, Cocos Island (off Costa Rica), Isla Malpelo (off Colombia), and Islas Desventuradas (off northern Chile), islands (including peripheral ones) in Caribbean, Fernando de Noronha, Abrolhos, and Trindade (off Brazil), and Ascension and St. Helena (South Atlantic)

species.name: African Darter
species.range: widespread sub-Saharan Africa along slow-moving rivers, freshwater and alkaline lakes, swamps, and mangroves, from Senegambia eastward to Sudan, Ethiopia, and Somalia, and southward to South Africa, Madagascar, and wetlands of lower Tigris–Euphrates in Iraq and Iran; extirpated in Türkiye

species.name: Reed Cormorant
species.range: widespread sub-Saharan Africa along slow-flowing rivers, ponds, swamp, coastal estuaries, mangroves, and coastal islets, from Mauritania eastward to Sudan, Eritrea, and western Somalia, and southward to South Africa, and on Madagascar

species.name: Cape Cormorant
species.range: coastal southwestern Namibia southward to southern South Africa

species.name: Great Cormorant
species.range: inland central Europe and Africa eastward to northeastern Russia and Japan, in south through Indian subcontinent and Mongolia, and disjunctly Cambodia, Vietnam, and Borneo, south-central New Guinea, Australia (including Tasmania but excluding western deserts), main islands of New Zealand, Rennell (southern Solomon Islands), and New Caledonia, and coastal North Atlantic of western Greenland and western Europe, and eastern Canada to Maine; winters southward on coasts to Iberian Peninsula and Delaware

species.name: Socotra Cormorant
species.range: seacoasts and islands in Persian Gulf, Arabian Sea (off Oman), Gulf of Aden, Socotra, and perhaps Red Sea (off Eritrea)

species.name: Glossy Ibis
species.range: locally in eastern North and southern South America, Africa, Eurasia, and southern Asia to Australasia

species.name: African Sacred Ibis
species.range: sub-Saharan Africa and southeastern Iraq; formerly Egypt

species.name: Northern Bald Ibis
species.range: patchily distributed mountains of Morocco, Syria, and Red Sea area

species.name: Olive Ibis
species.range: disjunctly along lowland to montane streams and rivers in dense forest, and swamp forest, from Sierra Leone to Ghana, from southern Cameroon southward to Gabon and eastward to eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, and highlands of central Kenya and northeastern Tanzania; extinct on Príncipe (Gulf of Guinea)

species.name: Spot-breasted Ibis
species.range: Liberia to Cameroon, Gabon, Democratic Republic of the Congo, and far northeastern Angola

species.name: Hadada Ibis

species.name: Wattled Ibis

species.name: Eurasian Spoonbill

species.name: African Spoonbill

species.name: White-crested Tiger-Heron

species.name: Eurasian Bittern

species.name: Dwarf Bittern

species.name: Little Bittern

species.name: Yellow Bittern

species.name: Slaty Egret

species.name: Black Heron

species.name: Western Reef-Heron

species.name: White-backed Night Heron

species.name: Little Heron

species.name: Rufous-bellied Heron

species.name: Squacco Heron

species.name: Malagasy Pond-Heron

species.name: Indian Pond-Heron

species.name: Great Egret

species.name: Yellow-billed Egret
species.range: sub-Saharan Africa

species.name: Gray Heron

species.name: Purple Heron

species.name: Humblot's Heron

species.name: Black-headed Heron
species.range: grassland and savanna of sub-Saharan Africa

species.name: Goliath Heron
species.range: locally in Africa, Iraq, and Iran; casual to India and Sri Lanka

species.name: Hamerkop
species.range: southwestern Arabia, tropical Africa, and Madagascar

species.name: Shoebill
species.range: swamps of South Sudan and southwestern Ethiopia to southern Democratic Republic of the Congo and northern Zambia; irregular non-breeding visitor in Central African Republic

species.name: Great White Pelican
species.range: locally in south-central Eurasia, southern Asia, and Africa

species.name: Pink-backed Pelican
species.range: locally in sub-Saharan Africa and Madagascar

species.name: Secretarybird
species.range: savanna and grassland of sub-Saharan Africa

species.name: Osprey
species.range: breeds Palearctic, Sulawesi and Java to New Guinea, coastal Australia (except Tasmania), New Caledonia, Canada to southern USA, and Caribbean; northern populations winter to South Africa, India, Philippines, and South America southward to Peru and Brazil

species.name: Scissor-tailed Kite

species.name: Black-winged Kite

species.name: Palm-nut Vulture

species.name: Bearded Vulture

species.name: Egyptian Vulture

species.name: African Cuckoo-Hawk

species.name: European Honey-buzzard

species.name: Oriental Honey-buzzard

species.name: White-headed Vulture

species.name: Cinereous Vulture

species.name: Lappet-faced Vulture

species.name: Hooded Vulture
species.range: savanna of sub-Saharan Africa

species.name: White-backed Vulture
species.range: open plains and savanna of sub-Saharan Africa

species.name: Cape Griffon

species.name: Rüppell's Griffon
species.range: lowland to montane arid steppe, grassland, and cliffs, from southwestern Mauritania and Senegambia eastward across the Sahel to Sudan, Eritrea, Ethiopia, and northern Somalia, and southward to Kenya and northern Tanzania; irregular dry-season wandering

species.name: Eurasian Griffon

species.name: Bateleur

species.name: Western Banded Snake-Eagle

species.name: Southern Banded Snake-Eagle

species.name: Congo Snake-Eagle

species.name: Beaudouin's Snake-Eagle

species.name: Black-chested Snake-Eagle

species.name: Brown Snake-Eagle

species.name: Imperial Eagle

species.name: Long-tailed Hawk

species.name: Dark Chanting-Goshawk

species.name: Eastern Chanting-Goshawk

species.name: Pale Chanting-Goshawk

species.range: patchily distributed in wooded savanna, farmbush, and montane dry forest from Guinea and Sierra Leone eastward to eastern Nigeria and Cameroon, and from southern Chad, Central African Republic, and southern South Sudan to northeastern Uganda and western Kenya; partly migratory in non-breeding season

species.name: Streaky-headed Seedeater
species.range: patchy in lowland to submontane scrub, savanna and miombo, and Fynbos from central Angola and northeastern Namibia eastward to northwestern Mozambique, then southward through Zimbabwe and northeast Botswana to eastern and southern South Africa, avoiding Namib and Kalahari deserts; partially migratory in non-breeding season

species.name: Stripe-breasted Seedeater
species.range: eastern and southeastern South Sudan, Ethiopia, and western and central Kenya

species.name: Reichard's Seedeater
species.range: southeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo to Zambia, Tanzania, Malawi, and northern Mozambique

species.name: Brown-rumped Seedeater
species.range: juniper woodland of northern Ethiopia, Eritrea, and northwestern Somalia

species.name: Ankober Serin
species.range: montane scrub of central Ethiopia

species.name: Eurasian Linnet
species.range: temperate to subtropical western and central Palearctic in open lowland woodland, fields (alpine meadows in south): British Isles, southern Scandinavia eastward to Altay region (south-central Russia), northern Xinjiang (northwestern China), and far western Mongolia, in south to Madeira and Canary Islands (Macaronesia), Morocco to northern Libya, throughout Mediterranean to Turkey, Cyprus, Israel, western Jordan, and western Syria, through Caucasus, Iran, and northern Afghanistan to eastern Kazakhstan; makes short-distance movements in winter

species.name: Warsangli Linnet
species.range: montane juniper forest of northern Somalia

species.name: Yellow-crowned Canary
species.range: montane forest and alpine moorland in highlands from Eritrea, Ethiopia, and South Sudan southward to eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo and eastward to Kenya, thence southward to southern Tanzania and Malawi, and in west-central Angola; downslope wandering in non-breeding season

species.name: Cape Canary
species.range: montane forest, moorland, thornscrub and Fybos from eastern Zimbabwe and adjacent Mozambique to South Africa (southward to KwaZulu-Natal and Eswatini, and westward to Western Cape); downslope wandering in non-breeding season

species.name: Ethiopian Siskin
species.range: alpine moorlands of northern and central Ethiopia

species.name: Brown-rumped Bunting
species.range: mesic woodland of Sahel zone and northeastern Africa, from Senegal, far southern Mauritania to northern Guinea and eastward to western and southern Ethiopia, northern Uganda, and western Kenya

species.name: Rock Bunting
species.range: rocky and bushy slopes of subtropical to temperate montane western and central Palearctic: Iberian Peninsula and central France through southern Germany, Slovakia, and southwestern Russia through northern Iran and southern Turkmenistan to eastern Kazakhstan and western Xinjiang (northwestern China) and eastward to far western Mongolia; in south from Morocco to Tunisia, and Mediterranean to Israel, southern Iran and Afghanistan to central Himalayas; some move in winter to cultivation at lower elevations

species.name: Cinereous Bunting
species.range: dry rocky hills of south-central Western Palearctic: Lesbos and Chios (eastern Greece), Turkey, northern Iraq, and far northwestern Iran; winters to coastal southern Red Sea from northeastern Sudan through Eritrea and southwestern Arabian Peninsula

species.name: Ortolan Bunting
species.range: breeds Western Palearctic; winters Mediterranean environs, Arabia, and Africa

species.name: Cretzschmar's Bunting
species.range: breeds southern Europe to Türkiye; winters to northeastern Africa and Arabia

species.name: Cabanis's Bunting
species.range: broadleaf woodland of tropical Africa: Guinea and far southern Mali eastward to far southern Sudan and northwestern Uganda; Angola, southern Zimbabwe, and central Mozambique

species.name: Golden-breasted Bunting
species.range: open woodland of Sahel zone and disjunctly eastern and southern Africa: southern Mauritania to northern Eritrea and far northern Ethiopia; southern Democratic Republic of the Congo and far southern South Sudan through eastern Africa, southward through South Africa (except southwestern)

species.name: Somali Bunting
species.range: Sudan to Ethiopia, Somalia, Uganda, Kenya, and northeastern Tanzania

species.name: Cape Bunting
species.range: open rocky shrubland of southern Africa: southwestern Angola eastward to western Mozambique, southward through southern South Africa

species.name: Lark-like Bunting
species.range: southwestern African succulent and grassy Karoo: coastal central Angola to Namibia, Botswana, Zimbabwe, and western and central South Africa

species.name: Cinnamon-breasted Bunting
species.range: rocky hillsides of subtropical to tropical northeastern to southern Africa: Gabon eastward to northeastern Somalia and Socotra, and southern Arabian Peninsula southward through South Africa

species.name: Gosling's Bunting
species.range: southern Mauritania to southern Senegal, eastward to southeastern Chad, northeastern Central African Republic, southwestern Sudan, and northwestern South Sudan; possibly also far northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo

species.name: Striolated Bunting
species.range: rocky scrublands of subtropical northeastern Africa to southwestern Asia: patchily in northeastern Chad and eastern Egypt to northeastern Somalia and southward to northwestern Kenya; Sinai Peninsula, Israel, and western Jordan, Arabian Peninsula, southern Iran, northeastern Afghanistan to far western India; winters to fields of west-central India
